page.overview:
Who is Amanda?

Amanda is a temporary party member in Final Fantasy Adventure. She is the sister of Lester and a fellow Glaive Empire slave with Sumo.

Amanda was captured from her home in Menos and forced to fight monsters for the Dark Lord's entertainment along with the other slaves.

Some time after Sumo escape from Glaive Castle, Amanda escapes and makes her way back home to Menos, only to find her brother Lester has traveled to Jadd to play his harp. Upon arriving in Jadd, she discovers Lester has been imprisoned by the city's ruler, Davias. When Sumo lands in Menos after falling from Glaive's Airship, Amanda steals the pendant from him, hoping Davias will take it in exchange for freeing Lester. Instead, Davias turns Lester into a parrot, forcing Amanda to travel to the Cave of Medusa to get the tears from the Medusa to cure Lester.

Sumo opens the entrance of the cave and finds Amanda loitering about. He immediately ask why she took the pendant, but she tells him that it was for her brother's sake. Sumo tells her that he'll help her out.
